records.title: myScheme government scheme discovery
records.summary: myScheme is an official Government of India platform for discovering Central and State or Union Territory schemes and checking published eligibility information.
records.description: Use myScheme to discover schemes when the Sahayak repository does not yet contain a source-checked record. A directory result is a lead, not a final eligibility decision; confirm against the scheme detail and originating department source.

government_entity.name: Digital India Corporation
government_entity.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

expectations: Open the individual scheme record and originating department guideline before relying on eligibility, amount or deadline information

application.deadline_note: myScheme is a discovery platform; each scheme has its own application window.

records.title: National Government Services Portal
records.summary: The National Government Services Portal is an official directory of Central, State, district and local government services.
records.description: Use this directory to locate the responsible government service and originating department when a source-checked opportunity record is not yet available.

government_entity.name: National Informatics Centre
government_entity.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

expectations: Confirm service-specific rules on the linked originating government page

application.method: Search the official government services directory
application.deadline_note: Deadlines belong to individual services, not the directory.

records.title: National Scholarship Portal
records.summary: The National Scholarship Portal is the official application platform for multiple Central and participating State or Union Territory scholarships.
records.description: The portal does not have one universal scholarship deadline. Always identify the specific scholarship and academic year before stating eligibility, amount or closing date.
expectations: Check the specific scholarship notice and academic-year schedule

application.method: Search or apply through the National Scholarship Portal
application.deadline_note: Each scholarship and academic year has its own schedule.

records.title: Union Public Service Commission recruitment advertisements
records.summary: The Union Public Service Commission publishes official recruitment advertisements and vacancy notices for notified government posts.
records.description: Use the official advertisement and any corrigendum as the source for vacancy count, qualifications, age limits, fees and deadlines.
expectations: Check the vacancy-specific advertisement and latest corrigendum

application.method: Open the official recruitment advertisements page
application.deadline_note: Each advertisement has its own closing date and time.

records.title: Staff Selection Commission recruitment
records.summary: The Staff Selection Commission publishes official notices for Central Government recruitment examinations and posts.
records.description: Use the notice, calendar and corrigenda on the official Staff Selection Commission website for current application and examination details.
expectations: Check the recruitment-specific notice and latest corrigendum

application.method: Open the official Staff Selection Commission website
application.deadline_note: Each recruitment notice has its own schedule.

records.title: Railway Recruitment Board employment notices
records.summary: Official Railway Recruitment Board sites publish Centralised Employment Notices for Indian Railways recruitment.
records.description: Use the relevant official Railway Recruitment Board notice and corrigenda for zone, board, vacancy, qualification and deadline details.
expectations: Check the selected board, zone, employment notice and latest corrigendum

application.method: Open an official Railway Recruitment Board employment notice
application.deadline_note: Each Centralised Employment Notice has its own schedule.
